zuke-lightweight.gui.title: zukeLightweight Configs
zuke-lightweight.config.slotRefill.name: Slot Refill
zuke-lightweight.config.slotRefill.comme:
When the stack in your selected hotbar slot runs out,
swap in a matching stack from your main inventory.
zuke-lightweight.config.hotbarShuffle.co:
While on, placing a block randomly reselects another
placeable block from your hotbar.
zuke-lightweight.config.dragQuickMove.co:
Hold Shift and left-click, then drag across stacks to
quick-move (shift-click) each one you pass over.
zuke-lightweight.config.dragGather.name: Drag Gather
zuke-lightweight.config.dragGather.comme:
Pick up a stack and keep holding left-click: drag over stacks of the
same item to add them to your cursor stack (while they still fit).
With Shift held, those stacks are quick-moved instead.
zuke-lightweight.config.wheelTweak.name: Scroll Wheel Tweak
zuke-lightweight.config.wheelTweak.comme:
Scroll over a stack to move one item at a time between this
inventory and the other one (your inventory and a chest, say).
Scroll one way to push an item out, the other to pull a matching one in.
zuke-lightweight.config.wheelDirection.c:
Inventory Position Aware (default): scrolling toward the other inventory on screen
always pushes. Normal: scroll down pushes the item out, up pulls one in.
